LESSON: ANALYSIS OF CREATIVE ARTS WORKS

Grade: Grade 5
Subject: CREATIVE ARTS
Strand: Appreciation in Creative Arts
Topic 3.1: Analysis of Creative Arts works

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello! This is a study lesson on Analysis of Creative Arts works. Read the explanation, follow every worked example, then do the practice. This is original CBC Learn content written from KICD outcomes — not a copy of a commercial textbook.

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. Explain the main ideas in Analysis of Creative Arts works
2. Give Kenyan examples for Analysis of Creative Arts works
3. Practise Analysis of Creative Arts works at school and at home

SECTION 3: STUDY NOTES (READ AND LEARN)

WHAT YOU ARE LEARNING: ANALYSIS OF CREATIVE ARTS WORKS
This lesson teaches Analysis of Creative Arts works for Grade 5 CREATIVE ARTS.

   Practise this until you can do it without help.

HOW TO SHOW UNDERSTANDING
Explain the idea in your own words, give one Kenyan example, then complete the practice tasks.

SECTION 4: QUICK EXAMPLES

Example 1: Describe Analysis of Creative Arts works using something at your school.

Example 2: Give a home/community example from your county.

Example 3: Teach a younger child one idea from this lesson in simple words.

SECTION 5: PRACTICE NOW

2. Explain Analysis of Creative Arts works to a parent using one local example.
3. Write or draw three things that prove you understand Analysis of Creative Arts works.

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (HOME / REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about Analysis of Creative Arts works with school or home examples.
2. Answer: Why is Analysis of Creative Arts works important for a Grade 5 learner?
3. Prepare a one-minute oral presentation for a parent or teacher.
